# Test fixtures

Everything in this folder is **synthetic test data**. The load rows are invented to exercise the normalization and interpolation code, including deliberate errors. They are not load data. Never publish them or use them for reloading.

The fixture files use the provisional load file format (`schemaVersion` `0.1.0`) proposed to the load-data bot in [`BOTS.md`](../../BOTS.md). Powder names are placeholders and no charges are recorded.
